answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The relic of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The willow holds work receipts rather than names, so the quartz of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
